instruction.thesis: GOLD short entered at 4,661 with thesis of crowded longs (funding at 67.5% annualized). Gold spot has declined to 4,536 (-2.7% gain, approaching the 5% target). Critically, gold_hl_funding_ann has collapsed from +67.5% to -44.78% — a complete sign flip and 112pp swing — which is the primary signal-family evidence that the crowded-long thesis has fully resolved. Funding normalization and sign flip confirm the positioning unwind is complete. Taking profit near the 2.7% mark before funding reversal creates adverse carry on the short position.

instruction.thesis: BTC long entered at 79,093 based on promoted H-148 (put-call exhaustion reversal). BTC spot has declined to 78,455 (-0.81%), approaching the 1.5% mechanical stop. The signal-family evidence column (btc_spot) shows continued weakness with no bounce. BTC HL funding has crashed to -24.16% (a -2.9σ anomaly) indicating crowded perp shorts, but spot is not responding with a bounce — this is a bearish divergence suggesting the reversal thesis is not playing out. Closing proactively at -0.81% rather than waiting for the mechanical stop at -1.5% given the deteriorating price action and the fact that deeply negative funding with no spot bounce is a thesis-invalidating pattern for a long reversal trade.
